It does NOT contain range '-' (45) to '_' (95) and does NOT contain digits 48-57. '[' (91) is in Z-_ but '1' (49) is not, so substring "_bad[1].properties" contains a character not in the class and is not matched by "_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties". String.replaceAll finds no match and returns the input unchanged, so englishFile remains "/tmp/work/resources/theme/base/messages/messages_bad[1].properties", not "/tmp/work/resources/theme/base/messages/messages_en.properties". The intended class [a-zA-Z_-] also would not match, so both leave the path unchanged.
